card.name: Words leading into pregnancy-harm statements
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words just before a harm-to-fetus phrase, such as 'prevent', 'cause' or 'risk of' in pregnancy warnings. Also fires on 'fetal' right before 'harm'.

modes.label: Verb before pregnancy or birth defects
modes.description: The word 'prevent' or 'cause' right before pregnancy or birth defects.
modes.example: To<< prevent>> pregnancy, females of reproductive potential must use

modes.label: Cause fetal harm
modes.description: 'fetal' after 'may cause' or 'can cause', before the word harm.
modes.example: Retinoids may cause<< fetal>> harm when administered to a pregnant female [

modes.label: Linking word in risk phrases
modes.description: 'of' after evidence or risk, in reproductive-risk statements.
modes.example: Advise male patients with female partners of the potential risk<< of>> exposure through semen and to use effective contraception
